This shared use implies a potential overlap in their biological effects, possibly through similar pathways in the adrenal system. The indirect relationship between Prednisone and the target condition is supported by the presence of triamcinolone as a downstream mediator, suggesting a possible role in adrenal function or hormone regulation.
